levels.surface: عبد الله بن محمد بن عبد الرحمن الزهري

groups.saying_opens: ووضع يديه على جبهته وأمرها على أنفه

notes: Two sayings, each stored with its own route (rule 4a): the bowing on seven bones, and the hands on the forehead and nose («قال سفيان قال لنا ابن طاوس»). The second has its own transmitter, Ibn Tawus, reached through Sufyan.
«قال هذا واحد واللفظ لمحمد» is the compiler's remark on the wording: left out.
The two shaykhs head both routes; the second saying's chain stops at Ibn Tawus, as the text gives it.
